blurb: The Dorothy Quincy Homestead was the country seat of Edmund Quincy IV in the mid-18th century and home to three earlier generations of the influential and well-connected Quincy family. Originally built in 1681, the Homestead evolved to become a sophisticated home and gentleman’s farm by the period of the American Revolution.
